failure.detail: The fixed two-second hold design completed the partial canary phase but observed at most one Blue in-flight request while waiting for the unfrozen minimum of five. The asynchronous Triton receipt collectors outlived the fixed holds, so the switch gate was never reached.

rca: API and controller receipts commit synchronously inside the request, while Triton COMPUTE_START receipts are exported and committed asynchronously. Waiting for all four collectors after fixed sleeps allowed all four bridge requests to finish and decrement in-flight before the gate observed them. Extending sleep duration is timing-dependent and is not a causal proof.
remediation: Restore the immutable 0161 workload parameters. Reuse the existing causal switch event for one designated bridge, require the other 39 bridge requests to terminate on Blue, require the exact four-by-three committed/readback-visible actor receipt set, then switch and release exactly the causal hold plus designated bridge after route application.
